description: THD degree programme and cohort-start taxonomy containing records with substantiated programme codes. This is a discovery aid, not proof of enrolment.

codePolicy.verified: The code is the programme-page slug from THD's bachelor or master catalogue (th-deg.de/<code>-b or -m), upper-cased without the level suffix, and that page is in the record's sources.
codePolicy.provisional: No programme page carries this code yet; do not use it as a cohort identifier. No record is provisional in this version.

notes: The displayed semester is the cohort's current curriculum semester for the current academic term; it is not a promise that a student has passed every previous semester.
Keep AIN (English) and KI (German) as separate programmes.
Some programmes have different start terms by language variant or campus, so use each record's intakeTerms rather than assuming every programme starts in both terms.
Extension semesters 8 and 9 are allowed cohort labels, not separate programmes or intake terms.
Where the same short code has multiple campuses or study modes, include campus and study mode in the stable cohort key to avoid collisions.
Codes repeat across levels (KI, ET, MT, MB, ASW, WI, EM) and campuses (MCS in Deggendorf and Cham). Match batches on the record id, which is the page slug and unique, and show the code to people.

edgeCases.title: AIN and KI are separate programmes
edgeCases.details: AIN is the English-taught Artificial Intelligence B.Sc.; KI is the German-taught Künstliche Intelligenz B.Sc. Both have the English name Artificial Intelligence. Do not merge their cohorts.

edgeCases.title: The same code at two levels or two campuses
edgeCases.details: KI, ET, MT, MB, ASW, WI and EM each exist as a bachelor and a master; MCS runs in Deggendorf (winter start) and Cham (summer start). The id (page slug) is unique, the code is not.

edgeCases.title: Start terms differ by programme
edgeCases.details: International engineering variants, the English Nursing pathway and several masters start in summer, some masters in both terms. Use each record's intakeTerms.

edgeCases.title: Traffic Sciences intake
edgeCases.details: The Traffic Sciences page still says the programme was not offered in winter 2025/26. It stays in the list for existing cohorts and is marked intake_unverified.

edgeCases.title: Programmes left out
edgeCases.details: Car IT und Elektronik (ae-m) and Human Resource Management (hrm-m) are in the master catalogue but taught with or at OTH Regensburg, and their pages have no facts box. Discontinued programmes and part-time offers outside the two catalogues are not listed; students in them use the app's 'not listed' route.

edgeCases.title: Master's programmes and extension semesters
edgeCases.details: Master's programmes are separate degree-level identities with their own durations and start terms. Semesters 8 and 9 are a cohort-display allowance, not part of every curriculum.
